text: Concerns have been raised about vehicles parked on the north and south corners of Compton Crescent, which is dangerous for vehicles coming around the bend.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the east and north side of Compton Crescent, from a point 91 metres south of Calvington Drive (west intersection) to a point 23 metres further south and east. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the west and north side of Compton Crescent, from a point 77 metres south of Calvington Drive (east intersection) to a point 20 metres further south and west.
